notes.title: 01.09.2025 Game update
notes.notes:
Maintenance has been completed.

The following changes have been made to the game:

Dungeons:

🔹 Old dungeon stones have been removed and replaced with new ones
🔹 When selecting the Sky Fortress on the dungeon teleporter, the character is transferred to NPC High Priest Largal
🔹 The dungeon management menu has been removed from the dungeon manager NPC
🔹 The dungeon teleporter ownership menu has been updated

General Changes:

🔹 The NPC Coin Exchange Assistant now has a skill card combination menu
🔹 Resurrection window delay reduced from 5 seconds to 2 seconds
🔹 Help and Shop windows now close automatically upon death
🔹 Mounts can now be mounted/dismounted with a double-click or a hotkey (same as equipment)
🔹 Added commands:
  /ride — mount/dismount
  /sit — sit/stand

Interface:

🔹 Added quick access icons for key functions (e.g., guild buffs)
🔹 Management window opens with the T key
🔹 Updated commands linked to icons
🔹 Tooltips now display relevant commands when hovering over an icon

Guilds:

🔹 Maximum guild level increased to 20
🔹 Leveling beyond 16 costs 256M rupees
🔹 New guild buff buttons added: +10% and +15%
🔹 Guild level can only be raised once per week (resets on Monday at 00:00)
🔹 From level 10 onwards, 300 raid medals are required to level up
🔹 Required guild points for raids:

Ancient City Ruins — 10.0

Sky Fortress — 15.0

Twilight Dungeon — 20.0
🔹 Minimum guild level for raids: 10
🔹 Raids now drop Raid Medals in small amounts along with items

Raids & Sieges:

🔹 Low-level dungeon raids and sieges have been removed
🔹 Three new raid dungeons added:

Ancient City Ruins

Sky Fortress

Twilight Dungeon

Dungeon Ownership Buffs:

Ancient City Ruins
🔹 +3% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside ruins

Sky Fortress
🔹 +4% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside fortress

Twilight Underground City
🔹 +5% final damage
🔹 +10% EXP, MP, Luck, Rupees, Drop Chance inside city

Raid Rules:

🔹 Only guilds can register for raids (alliances do not count)
🔹 Raid duration: 1 hour
🔹 Period: Mon 00:00 ~ Sat 24:00
🔹 Ownership transfer: Sun 23:50
🔹 Dungeon ownership is automatically transferred based on raid results (no sieges)
🔹 The owning guild may defend their dungeon through raids
🔹 Only 1 raid attempt per day is allowed (counted from the start)
🔹 Abandoning a dungeon blocks raids until 24:00 of the same day
🔹 Buffs are now retained after death inside dungeons
🔹 Raid applications can be canceled during the week (if not yet completed)
🔹 If a guild abandons a dungeon, they cannot apply or form a raid group for 24 hours (previously 7 days)
🔹 Raid objective changed: now all monsters must be killed

Alliances:

🔹 Added alliance management commands:
  /gacreate [name] — create an alliance (guild leader only)
  /gainvite [guild] — invite a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gakick [guild] — expel a guild (alliance leader only)
  /gadestroy — disband the alliance (alliance leader only)
  /galeave — leave the alliance (if the leader leaves, the alliance disbands)

We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: Epic 9.8. New weapons and upgrade system changes
notes.notes:
Epic 9.8 brought a lot of interesting things in terms of weapons and accessories. Let's consider each aspect in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/cb09ffac141545df2951f1e306015ac9baf858bd.png[/img]
 
[h2]New weapons[/h2]

Update 9.8 contains new weapons and shields. The good news is that it's crafted from your old weapon, so valuable stats, upgrades, and soul gems will stay with you.
 
So, to upgrade your weapon from the Isle of the Forgotten Gods, you will need:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon from the Island,
[*] Auxiliary cell - a similar unfinished weapon from the Circus (can be unopened),
[*] Material slot - Luciad's pure energy (25 for one-handed weapons and 50 for two-handed weapons).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/fb5aeb71307b402e7e44bd713f6cf26a8bdae7e2.png[/img]

  The pure energy of Luciad can be obtained in the Labyrinth of Light.

[h2]Upgrade after +20[/h2]

The enchant system up to +25, which has already become familiar, has undergone significant changes in epic 9.8. First of all, the maximum level of improvement is now +20, and further improvement comes from increasing the strength of Luciad.
 
As soon as your item becomes +20, it gains 1 level of Luciad's power.
 
Luciad's maximum power level is +32 for all old armor and weapons, and 40 for new pure white weapons and shields.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/dd42ad298e764b65ce7308c44c249642dc3db6e5.png[/img]

To increase the power level of Luciad, you will need to place the following items in the enchantment window:
[list]
[*] the main enchantment slot is your weapon or armor,
[*] Auxiliary slot - Luciad's power: weapons/armor,
[*] material slot — pure or improved Lusiad's cube.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/4dc8d30fb833730ecc98553ea32c0149981d28f1.png[/img]

You can get Luciad Power for a weapon by combining any weapon that has at least one level of Luciad Power with the Luciad Power Extractor (purchased from a blacksmith for 200,000,000).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/853be79585727f55ad43f9d7102c4f04b8bcee68.png[/img]

The number of Extractors needed corresponds to the Luciad's power level of the original item: for example, to extract power from a weapon with a power level of 32, you would need 32 Extractors. Same with armor if you want to get Luciad's power for armor.
 
The Pure Cube of Luciad is used to boost Luciad's strength to +32 and below. You can get it as a drop from any bosses above level 150 or from the chest of the Labyrinth of Light.
 
Improved Luciad's Cube is needed to increase Luciad's strength from +33 to 40. You can get it in the Labyrinth of Light.
 
But what about things that have already been enchanted above +20? Don't worry, they will automatically change and get the Luciad power upgrade corresponding to their level of enchantment (statistics will not change):
Before -> Now (Luciad's power level)
[list]
[*] 20 -> 1
[*] 21 -> 2
[*] 22 -> 4
[*] 23 -> 8
[*] 24 -> 16
[*] 25 -> 32
[/list]

[h2]Awakening weapons and accessories[/h2]

If earlier the number of lines in the awakening of weapons and accessories was 5, now you can increase their number to 7, as well as change some options at your discretion.
 
To do this, you will need special awakening stones: Blessed Awakening Stone and Blessed Awakening Stone: accessories.
 
To get a stone of blessed awakening, combine a regular stone of awakening with the pure energy of Luciad. Similarly - with a stone for accessories.
 
If you are not satisfied with any of the proposed options, but like all the others, you can easily change just one line with the help of awakening stone I - VII.
 
Here's how it works: choose which stitch you want to change and apply the appropriate stone. For example, in this weapon we want to change the 4th line.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/695b9f104f4568ded94814838d4e789b6d5fa66a.png[/img]

Take awakening stone IV, combine it with weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/fe4d961bbf0fd9c3c14eab01a0fa472ca0e5e574.png[/img]

Result:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/3588f4d6680a5308a45d72747a9e5a06555272e0.png[/img]

Awakening stones for one line are purchased in the game store.

[h2]Soul Stones[/h2]

Serene Soul Stones (2) can now be upgraded to +5 or +10 with Energy Master. To upgrade to +5, you need Soulstone Essence (obtained in Labyrinth of Light).
 
Place the items of equipment that you want to improve the gems in in the Soul Gem Management window of the Energy Master. Place the essence of the soul stone in the bottom cell. Click on the button below the stone you want to upgrade.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541638/0bfe2001c0c18eb17da751373d9213b36522bc34.png[/img]

Upgrading above +5 will require Unstable Soulstone Essence (purchased from the in-game store).
 
You can find out what characteristics the improvement will bring to each stone in the knowledge base.
 
And perhaps that's all we wanted to tell you in this test diary. Next one is coming soon. stay tuned!
